summary.en: Four recent papers on retention-time prediction, spectral representation learning, targeted MRM and proteomics analysis.
summary.zh: 四篇近期方法文献，涵盖保留时间预测、谱图表征学习、靶向 MRM 与蛋白质组学分析。

en: Today we introduce four recent papers on computational methods for mass spectrometry: three journal articles and one preprint. The listed versions appeared online between September 29 and October 5, 2026; 2-step and PiProteline had earlier preprints.

The papers cover retention-time prediction, self-supervised spectrum learning, targeted quantification and proteomics analysis, with attention to transfer conditions, evaluation baselines and quality control.

This digest is a selection with limited coverage of recent ACS, Molecular & Cellular Proteomics and Talanta articles. Reading scope is stated for each paper. No independent experimental or computational reproduction was performed.
zh: 今天介绍四篇近期的质谱计算方法文献，包括三篇期刊论文和一篇预印本。所列版本首次在线日期为 2026 年 9 月 29 日至 10 月 5 日；2-step 和 PiProteline 此前已有预印本。
主题涵盖保留时间预测、谱图自监督学习、靶向定量与蛋白质组学分析，重点关注迁移条件、评测基线和质量控制。
本期仅选介部分近期研究，对 ACS、Molecular & Cellular Proteomics 和 Talanta 的覆盖有限。各篇均注明阅读范围；未进行独立实验或计算复现。

papers.title: Times are changing but order matters: transferable prediction of small-molecule liquid chromatography retention times

commentary.en: 2-step predicts retention order with a molecular graph model, then maps it to retention times using high-confidence anchors from the target reversed-phase LC system. In chemically heterogeneous splits, the authors report better performance on five of six datasets and a near tie on the sixth. Even without target-system training data, transfer needs target-system anchors, column descriptors and pH. HILIC is outside the demonstrated scope; some biological examples lack authentic-standard confirmation, and the evaluation splits may remain optimistic.
commentary.zh: 2-step 先用分子图模型预测保留顺序，再以目标反相 LC 体系的高置信锚点映射为保留时间。在化学类别差异较大的划分中，作者报告六个数据集上五胜一近似持平。即使训练未用目标体系数据，迁移仍需其锚点、柱参数和 pH。HILIC 尚未验证；部分生物学示例缺少真实标准品确认，评测划分仍可能偏乐观。

publication_status.en: Peer-reviewed journal article. An earlier ChemRxiv preprint exists; the first-online date shown is for the journal version, not the first disclosure of the study.

papers.title: dIon: Fragmentation-Based Invariance for Self-Supervised Learning of Tandem Mass Spectra

commentary.en: dIon learns from precursor-conditioned spectrum mixtures and precursor-withheld partial spectra to emphasize fragment evidence. Under matched downstream training, the authors report a 2.3–8.4 percentage-point gain in peptide precision over training from scratch. Frozen representations do not beat a simple binned spectral-angle baseline; the strongest retrieval needs supervised adaptation. Search-engine-derived labels may carry selection bias and identification errors, and computation is costly. This preprint evaluates peptides/proteomics; transfer to metabolomics is unproven.
commentary.zh: dIon 用前体条件化混合谱和隐藏前体的局部谱学习表征，强调碎片证据。在相同下游训练条件下，作者报告肽段精确率较从头训练提高 2.3–8.4 个百分点。冻结表征未超过简单的分箱谱角基线，最佳检索结果仍需监督适配。搜索引擎标签可能带入选择偏差与鉴定错误，计算成本也较高。本研究为预印本，肽段与蛋白质组学结果尚不能证明向代谢组学的迁移效果。

papers.title: MRMhub: a scalable data-processing framework for large-scale targeted metabolomics

commentary.en: MRMhub integrates targeted MRM peak processing, quantification and QC. INTEGRATOR uses cross-sample chromatographic patterns to address retention-time drift and interference; QUANT handles validation, quantification, artefact correction, filtering and QC reports. Official examples cover 937 samples with 503 features and 4,591 samples with 829 features, demonstrating scale rather than independently validated accuracy. Without the complete paper and supplementary benchmarks, accuracy advantages or speedups cannot be assessed here. Its results do not establish untargeted metabolite identification performance.
commentary.zh: MRMhub 整合靶向 MRM 峰处理、定量与 QC。INTEGRATOR 利用跨样本色谱模式处理保留时间漂移和干扰；QUANT 提供验证、定量、伪影校正、过滤及 QC 报告。官方示例包括 937 样本、503 特征和 4,591 样本、829 特征，说明处理规模，并非独立准确度评测。本期未取得完整论文及补充基准，无法判断准确度优势或提速幅度；结果也不能泛化为非靶向代谢物鉴定。

papers.title: PiProteline: An R Package for Integrated Proteomics Data Analysis, from Label-Free Quantitation to Systems Biology

commentary.en: PiProteline integrates label-free abundance preprocessing, differential analysis, enrichment and protein-interaction networks in R/Shiny. On a spike-in benchmark, the authors report performance similar to DEP and protti, below limma. Per-sample-maximum merging of same-gene isoforms loses isoform information. Weighted networks call for 20–30 samples per group; pairwise-complete correlations do not resolve missing-data mechanisms. The empirical composite network measure is not a calibrated discovery probability. Input must be abundance-scale; log2 intensities are not automatically back-transformed.
commentary.zh: PiProteline 在 R/Shiny 中整合无标记丰度预处理、差异分析、功能富集和蛋白互作网络。作者在掺样基准中报告，其表现与 DEP、protti 相近，弱于 limma。按逐样本最大值合并同基因异构体会丢失异构体信息。加权网络建议每组 20–30 个样本；成对完整观测相关性仍未解决缺失机制，经验性网络综合指标也不是校准后的发现概率。输入须为丰度尺度，软件不会自动将 log2 强度转回线性丰度。

publication_status.en: Peer-reviewed journal article. An earlier preprint was posted on 2026-07-14 (10.20944/preprints202607.0993.v1); the first-online date shown is for the journal version.
